programme.title: Koyelaanchal
programme.desc: An honest IAS officer rises against the atrocities of a brutal mafioso. In retaliation, the mafioso sends a deadly human weapon to kill the officer, who instead ends up abducting his child.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Johny I Love You
programme.desc: Suraj Singh, a former bandit, relocates to a small hillside after the death of his wife, Savitri. He changes his son Raju's name to Johny to save him from the wrath of his former partner.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Ranbanka
programme.desc: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Trip
programme.desc: A group of friends travel through a dense forest and encounter two men, who they mistake for killers. The longer they stay in the woods, the more dangerous the situation becomes.

programme.title: Yeh Hai Judgement...
programme.desc: Ashraf Ansari, a local resident of Mumbai, is taken into custody as a suspect for the bomb blast that shakes the entire city. He battles with the police and the corrupt system to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Khatarnak Khel
programme.desc: A young girl loses her parents in an accident due to illegal bike racers in Chennai. She soon sets out to exact revenge on the racer responsible for her parents' death.

programme.title: Majaal
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her, but on several occasions, he is disrespected by his in-laws. Frustrated, he loses interest in his married life.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Zakhmi Aurat
programme.desc: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law in her own hands.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Pataakha
programme.desc: Badki and Chhutki are two sisters who constantly keep fighting with one another. However, when they get married, they understand each other's importance and build a stronger bond.

programme.title: Keemat
programme.desc: Two crooks accidentally kill a man and decide to inform his parents about the bad news. However, once they meet the family, they end up lying to them.

programme.title: Krantiveer
programme.desc: After being disowned by his family, Pratap, a juvenile gambler, ends up in Mumbai where he gets adopted by Laxminath, a landlord. However, when Laxminath is murdered, Pratap vows to avenge him.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: Anokhi Ada
programme.desc: Lalaji and Gupta, two business partners, take their relationship to the next level when their children, Rakesh and Neeta, marry each other. However, chaos ensues when Lalaji helps Gopal, a stranger.

programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.title: Badmash No.1
programme.desc: Ram, the son of Bhavani Shankar, and Anjali, the daughter of Narasimha, fall in love with each other while living abroad. Upon their return to India, they try to reunite their warring fathers.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Sweekar Kiya Maine
programme.desc: After Gopika and Kishan get married, she learns that her husband is a widower and has a child. She leaves him but later returns, asking him to accept her son from a previous relationship.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki

programme.title: Krishna Arjun

programme.title: Viduthalai Part 1

programme.title: Batman

programme.title: Batman

programme.title: Mera Gaon Mera Desh
programme.desc: A reformed man bravely opposes a ruthless village tyrant, but when his beloved is kidnapped, the confrontation turns personal, forcing a fierce battle for justice.

programme.title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
programme.desc: A powerful smuggler faces a vengeful enemy while juggling politics and crime. A public apology sparks a tense showdown that leads to a dramatic challenge.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: Vijaypath
programme.desc: Justice Saxena sentences a criminal to death. Seeking revenge, Dilawar Singh kills the judge's family and driver. The driver's son, devastated, vows to fight back and settle the score.

programme.title: Prem Granth
programme.desc: Somen, the privileged son of a wealthy upper-caste priest, falls in love with Kajri, a woman from a lower social group, but their budding romance is disrupted when she suddenly leaves the village.

programme.title: Zubeidaa
programme.desc: Zubeidaa, an aspiring Muslim actress, marries a Sikh prince as his second wife. Their turbulent relationship and her inner struggles lead to a fateful decision with tragic consequences for all.

programme.title: Toilet: Ek Prem Katha
programme.desc: Keshav marries Jaya and adores her, but their happiness falters when she protests the lack of a toilet at home. As tensions rise, he struggles to appease her with temporary fixes.

programme.title: 2.0 Robot
programme.desc: (Movies @6) When mobile phones mysteriously fly from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and Nila investigate. To stop Pakshi Rajan's chaos, they must revive Chitti for a decisive battle.

programme.title: Singham Again
programme.desc: When ruthless enemies kidnap his beloved wife, fearless police officer Bajirao Singham rallies his trusted force to execute a high-stakes, explosive rescue mission and bring justice.

programme.title: The Bengal Files
programme.desc: Set during one of India's most turbulent eras, the story portrays people's struggle to survive with dignity, fight injustice and claim their fundamental freedom to exist.

programme.title: Tigers: Can A Salesman Be A Hero?
programme.desc: A pharma salesman in Pakistan takes on his own company after discovering they knowingly marketed harmful baby formula, risking everything to expose the truth.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: Turtle
programme.desc: Ramkaran struggles to extract water in a drought-hit village. As thirst grows, villagers search for desperate solutions, revealing the harsh realities of survival and hope.

programme.title: Koi Mil Gaya
programme.desc: Rohit, a mentally challenged youth, befriends an alien. When police discover the creature, they try to capture it, while Rohit bravely protects his extraordinary friend against all odds.

programme.title: Krrish
programme.desc: Krrish, gifted with superhuman powers, falls for Priya and travels to Singapore, where shocking truths about his father push him to embrace destiny and fight.

programme.title: Seeta Aur Geeta
programme.desc: Seeta runs away from her cruel aunt. Her look-alike Geeta takes over but gets arrested. Seeta is forced back into a life of suffering.

programme.title: Attack
programme.desc: (Movies @6) After a terror attack leaves Arjun paralysed and grieving his lover, he joins a radical experiment when the attacker resurfaces, seeking revenge and a chance to fight back.

programme.title: Haq
programme.desc: In 1980s India, Shazia Bano fights for child support, but her husband's attempt to silence her through triple talaq sparks a nationwide debate on women's rights.

programme.title: Kites
programme.desc: Jay, a Las Vegas dance teacher, marries women for green cards. He weds Natasha for the same reason but unexpectedly falls in love when they reunite, complicating his plans.

programme.title: Race 3
programme.desc: While executing their biggest heist, a criminal family uncovers shocking truths that put their relationships and loyalties to the ultimate test.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: Tumbbad
programme.desc: A family builds a shrine for Hastar, a dangerous monster. When they try to take his cursed treasure, scary things start happening, and their lives turn into a nightmare.

programme.title: Mr. India
programme.desc: Arun shelters a group of orphans and is harassed by a gangster eyeing his house. After a child dies, he uses his father's invisibility watch to fight back.

programme.title: Kalki 2898 AD
programme.desc: In a ravaged world, a brave group races to protect a woman carrying Lord Vishnu's final avatar, Kalki, from Yaskin - the ruthless god-king bent on destroying her destiny.

programme.title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
programme.desc: Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

programme.title: Saturday Blockbuster- Wanted
programme.desc: Fearless hitman Radhe operates without mercy for anyone who pays, yet he desperately seeks redemption after falling hard for Jhanvi, who despises his brutal, violent life of crime.

programme.title: Singh Is King
programme.desc: Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

programme.title: Ram Teri Ganga Maili
programme.desc: Ganga sets out for Calcutta with her son after her husband leaves them. Hoping for a better life, she is betrayed along the way and ends up trapped in a brothel.

programme.title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3
programme.desc: Kanhaiya, an adult film actor in Thailand, falls for Shalu. To win over her traditional father, he fakes a respectable family with help from his quirky co-stars.

programme.title: Turtle
programme.desc: Ramkaran struggles to extract water in a drought-hit village. As thirst grows, villagers search for desperate solutions, revealing the harsh realities of survival and hope.

programme.title: Thalapathy Is The G.O.A.T.
programme.desc: Gandhi, an undercover agent, faces turmoil after a tragic mission. Years later, he encounters a young man claiming to be his son, Jeevan. Secrets unravel as danger looms.

programme.title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
programme.desc: Ramkishan and Mamta live happily with their sons. But when tragedy strikes their daughter, Mamta's heart changes, and she turns against her kind stepson, Vivek.

programme.title: Baazigar
programme.desc: A ruthless killer seeking revenge seduces a businessman's elder daughter, stages her murder as suicide, then sets out to destroy the rest of her family.

programme.title: Super Cinema Blockbuster- Sholay
programme.desc: Thakur Baldev hires Jai and Veeru to capture Gabbar, the dacoit who wiped out his family. They find love along the way, but fate decides otherwise.

programme.title: Mega Double Premiere- Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
programme.desc: Amid the events of the 26/11 attacks, chaos, pain and darkness engulf Cama Hospital, as 400 patients look to the hospital staff to guide them through a catastrophe.

programme.title: Pati Patni Aur Who Do
programme.desc: Chintu Tyagi finds his quiet marriage to Vedika thrown into complete chaos when a vibrant young fashion designer named Tapasya enters his world and steals his heart.

programme.title: Pure Bollywood
programme.desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

programme.title: Jawaani Jaaneman
programme.desc: Jazz, a carefree 40-year-old casanova in London, has his world turned upside down when Tia, claiming to be his daughter, enters his life and forces him to change.

programme.title: Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon
programme.desc: Sanjana is to get married with NRI Prem. However, theres a chaos when she falls in love with his employee Prem Kishen while Prem Kumar is delayed. How will it affect Sanjana?

programme.title: Aashiq Hoon Baharon Ka
programme.desc: Framed for stealing uranium, a dedicated scientist battles to clear his name, uncover conspiracies, and protect the woman he loves in this gripping romantic thriller.

programme.title: Suhaag
programme.desc: Ajay and Raj, notorious college pranksters, constantly land in trouble. When Ajay applies for a passport, he uncovers a shocking secret about his real identity, changing his life.

programme.title: Koyla

programme.title: Ghatak: Lethal
programme.desc: Kashi witnesses the brutal rule of Katya during a visit with his father. As he dares to resist the oppression, his actions endanger the lives of his family and loved ones.

programme.title: Cheeni Kum
